ABOUT THE JOURNAL

A dedicated platform for scientific scholarship.

The Journal of Physical Sciences Advances (JPSA) is intended to provide a scholarly forum for original contributions and developments across the physical sciences.

The journal's scope encompasses theoretical, experimental, computational and interdisciplinary research in relevant scientific fields.

Discover JPSA →
SUBJECT COVERAGE

Research areas

The journal's intended subject coverage includes the following areas.

Theoretical Physics
Applied Physics
Condensed Matter Physics
Materials Physics
Optics and Photonics
Computational Physics
Nuclear and Particle Physics
Interdisciplinary Physical Sciences
